content.short: Tranglo is a cross-border payment and remittance network covering more than 100 countries out of Asia.
content.description: Tranglo connects money service businesses and corporates to payout partners across Asia and beyond, running three products covering remittance processing, business payments and mobile airtime top ups. The network reaches more than 100 countries through over 5,000 payout partners, and has processed upwards of 24 billion dollars. It is licensed by Bank Negara Malaysia and the Monetary Authority of Singapore and certified to ISO 27001. Ripple holds a stake in the company, which connects Tranglo corridors to blockchain based settlement.
